say:1:1622302001:1.text: Oh! Perfect timing! I'm Pracel, president of the academy's fishing club.
say:1:1622302001:1.source_cn: 啊！同学，你来得正好！我是学院的钓鱼社社长帕拉塞。
say:1:1622302001:1.male: Oh! Perfect timing! I'm Pracel, president of the academy's fishing club.
say:1:1622302001:1.female: Oh! Perfect timing! I'm Pracel, president of the academy's fishing club.

say:2:1622302002:1.text: My prized fish king, <style="highlight">starglider</style>, is missing!
say:2:1622302002:1.source_cn: 我的宝贝鱼王<style=highlight>幻灵星游...

say:3:1622302003:1.text: And this little guy ,<style="highlight">Hootie</style>, is my owl. Handles my night mail.

say:4:1622302004:1.text: It spends all day glued to the starglider. It has to know something.
say:4:1622302004:1.source_cn: 它整天跟幻灵星游腻在一块儿，肯定知道些内情。

say:5:1622302005:1.text: But my transfiguration is awful... Talking to it feels like yelling across the Skyrealm Forest and hoping the trees answer!
say:5:1622302005:1.source_cn: 可问题是，我这半吊子变形术……和它沟通起来就跟隔着空境...

choice_prompt:7:1622302006.source_cn: 你的<style=highlight>变形术</style>水平怎么样？

say:9:1622302010:1.text: Please, help me talk to Hootie. Ask where my starglider went.
say:9:1622302010:1.source_cn: 拜托你，帮我翻译一下，问问咕咕，幻灵星游到底去哪了？
say:9:1622302010:1.male: Please, help me talk to Hootie. Ask where my starglider went.
say:9:1622302010:1.female: Please, help me talk to Hootie. Ask where my starglider went.

choice_prompt:10:1622302010.text: Please, help me talk to Hootie. Ask where my starglider went.
choice_prompt:10:1622302010.source_cn: 拜托你，帮我翻译一下，问问咕咕，幻灵星游到底去哪了？
choice_prompt:10:1622302010.male: Please, help me talk to Hootie. Ask where my starglider went.
choice_prompt:10:1622302010.female: Please, help me talk to Hootie. Ask where my starglider went.

say:11:1622302011:1.text: Oh, come on, we're not talking about just any fish. The starglider is something only the most seasoned angler ever manage to catch!
say:11:1622302011:1.source_cn: 哎呀，那可是幻灵星游！只有成熟顶尖的钓鱼大师才有机会钓到！

choice_prompt:12:1622302011.text: Oh, come on, we're not talking about just any fish. The starglider is something only the most seasoned angler ever manage to catch!
choice_prompt:12:1622302011.source_cn: 哎呀，那可是幻灵星游！只有成熟顶尖的钓鱼大师才有机会钓到！

say:13:1622302012:1.text: There are too many things to list, but the most remarkable part is its body! It looks like a crystal that breathes. Completely transparent. It lives by absorbing light the way other creatures absorb air.
say:13:1622302012:1.source_cn: 不可胜数！但最绝的，就是它的身体像一块会呼吸的水晶，通...

say:14:1622302013:1.text: That's why its tank has to be filled with glowstones charged with illumination magic.
say:14:1622302013:1.source_cn: 所以，它住的水箱里，需要缀满注入了照明术的辉光石。

say:15:1622302014:1.text: On starlit nights, it becomes incredibly lively! Watching it move is like watching a handful of stars dancing through water!
say:15:1622302014:1.source_cn: 一到星光璀璨的夜晚，它就会变得无比活跃！跟抓了一捧星星...

say:16:1622302015:1.text: And to be honest, catching it myself was a miracle, and it's the reason I was chosen as president of the fishing club.
say:16:1622302015:1.source_cn: 不瞒你说，我正是靠着钓到它的天大运气，才当上钓鱼社社长的。
say:16:1622302015:1.male: And to be honest, catching it myself was a miracle, and it's the reason I was chosen as president of the fishing club.
say:16:1622302015:1.female: And to be honest, catching it myself was a miracle, and it's the reason I was chosen as president of the fishing club.

choice_prompt:17:1622302015.male: And to be honest, catching it myself was a miracle, and it's the reason I was chosen as president of the fishing club.
choice_prompt:17:1622302015.female: And to be honest, catching it myself was a miracle, and it's the reason I was chosen as president of the fishing club.

say:18:1622302016:1.text: Well... there are reasons. Let me put it that way.
say:18:1622302016:1.source_cn: 呃……有些隐情现在暂时不方便透露。

say:19:1622302017:1.text: Look, you are clearly better at transfiguration than I am. Help me talk to Hootie and I promise I'll explain everything!
say:19:1622302017:1.source_cn: 总之，你的变形术那么厉害，先帮我翻译一下，具体情况我保...

say:19:1622302017:1.female: Look, you are clearly better at transfiguration than I am. Help me talk to Hootie and I promise I'll explain everything!

choice_prompt:20:1622302017.source_cn: 总之，你的变形术那么厉害，先帮我翻译一下，具体情况我保证一会儿就告诉你！
choice_prompt:20:1622302017.male: Look, you are clearly better at transfiguration than I am. Help me talk to Hootie and I promise I'll explain everything!
choice_prompt:20:1622302017.female: Look, you are clearly better at transfiguration than I am. Help me talk to Hootie and I promise I'll explain everything!

say:21:1622302018:1.text: Thank you! And if you ever want a leadership role, I will personally recommend you for the next fishing club president election!
say:21:1622302018:1.source_cn: 太感谢了！下一届钓鱼社社长选举，我一定全力推荐你做社长！
say:21:1622302018:1.male: Thank you! And if you ever want a leadership role, I will personally recommend you for the next fishing club president election!
say:21:1622302018:1.female: Thank you! And if you ever want a leadership role, I will personally recommend you for the next fishing club president election!

choice:20:0:1.text: Fine. I'll help. I'm generous like that.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 帮你一次，谁让我是个好人呢
choice:20:0:1.male: Fine. I'll help. I'm generous like that.
choice:20:0:1.female: Fine. I'll help. I'm generous like that.

choice:20:1:2.text: I can help, but what's in it for me?
choice:20:1:2.male: I can help, but what's in it for me?
choice:20:1:2.female: I can help, but what's in it for me?

choice:17:0:1.text: Ask a professor to translate for you.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 为什么不找变形术老师帮你翻译？
choice:17:0:1.male: Ask a professor to translate for you.
choice:17:0:1.female: Ask a professor to translate for you.

choice:10:0:1.text: Club president losing sleep over a fish?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 堂堂钓鱼社社长，还在乎一条鱼？
choice:10:0:1.male: Club president losing sleep over a fish?
choice:10:0:1.female: Club president losing sleep over a fish?

choice:10:1:2.text: Why not just catch another one?
choice:10:1:2.male: Why not just catch another one?
choice:10:1:2.female: Why not just catch another one?

choice:7:0:1.text: I'm a master of the craft!
choice:7:0:1.male: I'm a master of the craft!
choice:7:0:1.female: I'm a master of the craft!

say:23:1622302008:1.text: Oh yeah? Funny, every real master I've met insists they're just an "apprentice."
say:23:1622302008:1.source_cn: 别骗我了，只有真正的大师才会自称学徒。

say:24:1622302009:1.text: Besides, that confidence in your voice gives you away. I'd bet my life you're a transfiguration master!
say:24:1622302009:1.source_cn: 而且，回答得这么斩钉截铁，倒像是个谦逊的变形术高手！
